name: John Edward Hinkle

events.place: St. Mary's Cemetery, Winnipeg, Manitoba, Canada

notes:
John's mother was Phyllis Hinkle and I believe his father's name was Joseph. He also had a brother, Joseph A. Hinkle, and a sister Adelaide (Mrs. William Pugh).  For many years this family shared a cottage at Brereton Lake.

-Allan Zelmer
